comment_regular: [Verified] Initializes a NiTStringPointerMap<ShaderBufferEntry*> with 0x25 buckets and, for a positive package index, formats shaderpackage%03i.sdp. Oblivion then loads that SDP record map for shader creation. [Verified cross-build divergence] Fallout Renderer::Init exposes bCreateShaderPackage and forwards it to BSShaderManager::bCreateNewShaderPackage, while its HLSL creator resolves source files and compiles them; the current Fallout IDB does not establish a same-name Oblivion-style SDP map.
